head: 4a57db33476f1caf3e85726a6b1e189c68c1f36b
rationale: A draw path starts trusting a cached size that only one of its callers fills in, so other widgets that draw expanded text lay it out at width 0. ocra reported it on this pull request, and an AACR-Bench reference flags the same line as a cache that can be wrong. The first C case.

expect.concern: With LV_TEXT_FLAG_EXPAND the width now comes from dsc->text_size, which only lv_label sets; the roller, table cells and one-line textarea placeholders set EXPAND on a zeroed descriptor, so their text is laid out with width 0.
